blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Lee Jae Myung on Tuesday presented the historic cooperation among South Korea, China and Japan as a model for navigating today’s crises, pointing to how the three found common economic ground despite differences. Lee made the remarks at the Asean Plus Three summit in Manila, the Philippines, attended by Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and China’s Agriculture and Rural Affairs Minister Zhang Zhu, alongside leaders of the Southeast Asian bloc. “Trilateral cooperation among Korea, China and Japan also began right here in Manila,” Lee said, recalling a landmark meeting in 1999 that laid the foundation for cooperation […]...
